use IO.Std.write_line

let i mut = 0

let sum = (low: int, high: int, term: () -> double) -> double => (
    let total mut = 0.0D

    i = low

    while i <= high do
        total = total + term()

        i = i + 1
    od

    total
)

write_line("{sum(1, 100, () => 1.0D / cast(i))}")
